Retirees born on or before the 10th of a month will receive this payment on Wednesday, Oct. 14. The second round will go out on Oct. 21 to those born between […]

analysis.summary: The first round of October Social Security payments for retirees will be distributed on October 14, with the maximum payment amount capped at $5,181. Retirees born on or before the 10th of a month will receive payments on that date, with a second round scheduled for October 21 for those born between the 11th and the end of the month.
